result.instructions: Tools for MaidCentral, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the service types and frequencies we offer, then price a weekly standard clean for a 3-bedroom home."; "Create a lead for Jane Smith, 555-0100, postal code 29405, from the Google source."; "Which dates are open next week for a 3-hour deep clean?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MaidCentral data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run maidcentral_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run maidcentral_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run maidcentral_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. maidcentral_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: maidcentral_list_scope_groups
tools.title: List scope groups
tools.description: List service categories (scope groups) with their scopes of work and frequency ids. Start here: the ids feed quotes, pricing and bookings. API: GET /api/Lead/ScopeGroups.

tools.name: maidcentral_list_scopes
tools.title: List scopes of a scope group
tools.description: List the scopes of work (and frequencies) of one scope group. API: GET /api/Lead/Scopes.

annotations.title: List scopes of a scope group

tools.name: maidcentral_list_scope_frequencies
tools.title: List frequencies of a scope
tools.description: List the frequency options (one-time, weekly, ...) of one scope. API: GET /api/Lead/ScopeFrequencies.

tools.name: maidcentral_list_questions
tools.title: List pricing questions for scopes
tools.description: List the questions (home size, bedrooms, ...) and answer options for one or more scopes. Required questions must be answered in quotes and pricing. API: GET /api/Lead/Questions.

tools.name: maidcentral_list_rate_modifications
tools.title: List rate modifications
tools.description: List the extras, discounts and other rate modifications available for a scope group. API: GET /api/Lead/RateModifications.

tools.name: maidcentral_list_available_dates
tools.title: List available job dates
tools.description: List dates on which a quoted job of a given length or price can be booked for a scope group. Give hours or amount. API: GET /api/Lead/Availability.

hours.description: Job length in hours (hours or amount is required).

amount.description: Job amount (hours or amount is required).

end_date.description: End date, ISO 8601. Default one month from today.

tools.name: maidcentral_list_postal_codes
tools.title: List serviceable postal codes
tools.description: List the postal codes the company serves, with their home zone. API: GET /api/Lead/PostalCodes.

tools.name: maidcentral_list_customer_sources
tools.title: List customer sources
tools.description: List customer (lead) sources. API: GET /api/Lead/CustomerSources.

tools.name: maidcentral_list_billing_terms
tools.title: List billing terms
tools.description: List billing terms usable when booking. API: GET /api/Lead/BillingTerms.

tools.name: maidcentral_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List teams that jobs can be scheduled to. API: GET /api/Lead/Teams.

tools.name: maidcentral_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List tags with their category ids (lead tags = category 8, service set tags = 5, first job tags = 6). API: GET /api/Lead/Tags.

tools.name: maidcentral_list_note_types
tools.title: List note types
tools.description: List note types (Email = 1, Note = 2, PhoneCall = 3, TextMessage = 4). API: GET /api/Note/Types.

tools.name: maidcentral_get_lead
tools.title: Get a lead
tools.description: Get a lead by id: contact details, status, source, scope group and addresses. API: GET /api/Lead/Lead.

tools.name: maidcentral_get_quote
tools.title: Get a quote
tools.description: Get a quote by id: status, addresses, and per-scope and per-frequency prices, hours and booked state. API: GET /api/Lead/Quote.

tools.name: maidcentral_calculate_price
tools.title: Calculate price
tools.description: Calculate a price for scopes, frequencies, extras and question answers without creating a lead or quote. Stores nothing. API: POST /api/Lead/CalculatePrice.

FrequencyId.description: Frequency id for this scope (from maidcentral_list_scope_groups).

BaseFee.description: Optional: override the calculated price for this scope/frequency.

Answer.description: Select lists: the AnswerId. Multiple select: comma-separated AnswerIds. Else plain text.

questions.description: Answers to the scope questions (use [] if none).

tools.name: maidcentral_create_or_update_lead
tools.title: Create or update a lead
tools.description: WRITE: create a lead, or update one when lead_id is given. The postal code must be in a home zone. By default MaidCentral may send the lead email, add the lead to campaigns and trigger webhooks: set send_lead_email, add_to_campaigns and trigger_webhook to false to avoid that. Without allow_duplicates, a matching contact links to the existing lead. API: POST /api/Lead/CreateOrUpdate.

postal_code.description: Must be inside the company's home zones.

notes.description: One note to attach to the lead.

send_lead_email.description: Send the lead email (vendor default true).

add_to_campaigns.description: Add to MaidCentral campaigns (vendor default true).

allow_duplicates.description: Create a new lead even when contact info matches (vendor default false).

tools.name: maidcentral_create_or_update_quote
tools.title: Create or update a quote
tools.description: WRITE: create a quote for a lead (or update one when quote_id is given) with service address, scopes, frequencies and question answers. Optionally emails the quote 5 minutes later (send_quote_email, default false). API: POST /api/Lead/CreateOrUpdateQuote.

billing_address1.description: Optional billing address (default: the service address).

FrequencyId.description: Frequency id for this scope (from maidcentral_list_scope_groups).

BaseFee.description: Optional: override the calculated price for this scope/frequency.

Answer.description: Select lists: the AnswerId. Multiple select: comma-separated AnswerIds. Else plain text.

questions.description: Answers to the scope questions (use [] if none).

send_quote_email.description: Email the quote to the lead after 5 minutes.

tools.name: maidcentral_book_quote
tools.title: Book a quote
tools.description: WRITE: convert a quote into a customer and schedule the first job on first_job_date. Check dates with maidcentral_list_available_dates first. Booking emails default to the vendor setting: set send_booked_email and send_customer_portal_invite to false to stay silent. API: POST /api/Lead/BookQuote.

FrequencyId.description: Frequency id for this scope (from maidcentral_list_scope_groups).

BaseFee.description: Optional: override the calculated price for this scope/frequency.

FirstJobDate.description: First job date, ISO 8601 (defaults to 9:00 AM; add a time to change it).

tools.name: maidcentral_create_note
tools.title: Create a note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note (or logged email, call, text) to a quote, customer or employee. Give entity_id with entity_type_id, or entity_contact_info (email or phone). API: POST /api/Note/Create.

entity_contact_info.description: Email or phone; searched in customers, leads, then employees.

subject.description: Required unless the note type is Email.

create_ticket.description: For communication notes: also create a ticket.

tools.name: maidcentral_add_utm_data
tools.title: Add UTM data to a lead
tools.description: WRITE: attach UTM campaign data to a lead or quote. Give lead_id, email or phone. API: POST /api/Lead/Utm.

annotations.title: Add UTM data to a lead
